```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

datos <- read.csv("../data/resultados.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
rangos <- read.csv("../data/rangos.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)



datos_long <- datos |>
 pivot_longer(N_Dumas:Aluminio,
              names_to="Nutriente",
              values_to="Valor") |>
 left_join(rangos, by="Nutriente") |>
 mutate(
   Estado=case_when(
     is.na(Min)|is.na(Max) ~ "Sin rango",
     Valor<Min ~ "Bajo",
     Valor>Max ~ "Alto",
     TRUE ~ "Óptimo"
   ),
   Etiqueta=paste0(substr(Finca,1,3),"-",Lote)
 )

anio_actual <- max(datos_long$Año)

datos_actual <- datos_long |>
  filter(Año == anio_actual)

comparacion <- datos_long |>
  select(
    Finca,
    Lote,
    Año,
    Nutriente,
    Valor,
    Min,
    Max
  )

nombres <- c(
  N_Dumas = "Nitrógeno (%)",
  Fosforo = "Fósforo (%)",
  Azufre = "Azufre (%)",
  Cloruros = "Cloruros (ppm)",
  Calcio = "Calcio (%)",
  Magnesio = "Magnesio (%)",
  Potasio = "Potasio (%)",
  Sodio = "Sodio (ppm)",
  Boro = "Boro (ppm)",
  Hierro = "Hierro (ppm)",
  Manganeso = "Manganeso (ppm)",
  Cobre = "Cobre (ppm)",
  Zinc = "Zinc (ppm)",
  Molibdeno = "Molibdeno (ppm)",
  Aluminio = "Aluminio (ppm)"
)

graficar <- function(df){

  ymin <- suppressWarnings(unique(na.omit(df$Min))[1])
  ymax <- suppressWarnings(unique(na.omit(df$Max))[1])

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(Etiqueta, Valor, fill = Estado))

  # Dibujar rango crítico
  if(!is.na(ymin) && !is.na(ymax)){
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = -Inf,
        xmax = Inf,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax,
        fill = "darkgreen",
        alpha = 0.15
      ) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = ymin,
        linetype = 2,
        colour = "darkgreen",
        linewidth = 0.7
      ) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = ymax,
        linetype = 2,
        colour = "darkgreen",
        linewidth = 0.7
      )+annotate(
  "text",
  x = Inf,
  y = ymin,
  label = paste0("Mín: ", ymin),
  colour = "darkgreen",
  hjust = 1.05,
  vjust = -0.3,
  fontface = "bold",
  size = 4
) +
annotate(
  "text",
  x = Inf,
  y = ymax,
  label = paste0("Máx: ", ymax),
  colour = "darkgreen",
  hjust = 1.05,
  vjust = -0.3,
  fontface = "bold",
  size = 4
)
      
  }

  # Unidad del eje Y
  unidad <- if(grepl(
    "Sat_|N_Dumas|Fosforo|Azufre|Calcio|Magnesio|Potasio",
    df$Nutriente[1]
  )){
    "Porcentaje (%)"
  } else{
    "Concentración (ppm)"
  }

  #----------------------------------------------------------
  # Configuración del eje Y
  #----------------------------------------------------------

  lim_inf <- min(df$Valor, ymin, na.rm = TRUE)
  lim_sup <- max(df$Valor, ymax, na.rm = TRUE)

  margen <- 0.08 * (lim_sup - lim_inf)

  breaks_y <- pretty(c(lim_inf, lim_sup))

  if(!is.na(ymin))
    breaks_y <- c(breaks_y, ymin)

  if(!is.na(ymax))
    breaks_y <- c(breaks_y, ymax)

  breaks_y <- sort(unique(round(breaks_y, 3)))

  #----------------------------------------------------------

  p +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = round(Valor, 2)),
      vjust = -0.35,
      size = 3.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Bajo" = "#d73027",
      "Óptimo" = "#1a9850",
      "Alto" = "#fdae61",
      "Sin rango" = "grey70"
    )) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = unidad
    )
}

graficar_comparacion <- function(df){
  
  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      Etiqueta = paste0(substr(Finca, 1, 3), "-", Lote)
    )

  ymin <- suppressWarnings(unique(na.omit(df$Min))[1])
  ymax <- suppressWarnings(unique(na.omit(df$Max))[1])

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = Etiqueta,
      y = Valor,
      fill = factor(Año)
    )
  )

  #--------------------------------------------------------
  # Rango crítico
  #--------------------------------------------------------

  if(!is.na(ymin) && !is.na(ymax)){

    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin=-Inf,
        xmax=Inf,
        ymin=ymin,
        ymax=ymax,
        fill="darkgreen",
        alpha=.15
      )+

      geom_hline(
        yintercept=ymin,
        linetype=2,
        colour="darkgreen"
      )+

      geom_hline(
        yintercept=ymax,
        linetype=2,
        colour="darkgreen"
      )+

      annotate(
        "text",
        x=Inf,
        y=ymin,
        label=paste0("Min: ",ymin),
        colour="darkgreen",
        hjust=1.05,
        size=4,
        fontface="bold"
      )+

      annotate(
        "text",
        x=Inf,
        y=ymax,
        label=paste0("Máx: ",ymax),
        colour="darkgreen",
        hjust=1.05,
        size=4,
        fontface="bold"
      )

  }

  #--------------------------------------------------------
  # Unidad
  #--------------------------------------------------------

  unidad <- if(grepl(
    "Sat_|N_Dumas|Fosforo|Azufre|Calcio|Magnesio|Potasio",
    df$Nutriente[1]
  )){

    "Porcentaje (%)"

  }else{

    "Concentración (ppm)"

  }

  #--------------------------------------------------------
  # Gráfico
  #--------------------------------------------------------

  p +

    geom_col(
  position = position_dodge2(
    width = .75,
    preserve = "single"
  ),
  width = .65
)+

    geom_text(
  aes(label = round(Valor,2)),
  position = position_dodge2(
    width = .75,
    preserve = "single"
  ),
  vjust = -0.35,
  size = 3.5
)+

    scale_fill_manual(
      values=c(
        "2024"="grey70",
        "2026"="#2C7FB8"
      ),
      name="Año"
    )+

    theme_minimal(base_size=14)+

    theme(
      axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
      legend.position="bottom"
    )+

    labs(
      x="",
      y=unidad
    )

}

df_prueba <- comparacion |>
    filter(Nutriente=="N_Dumas")

graficar_comparacion(df_prueba)
```


```{r results='asis',echo=FALSE}

for(nut in unique(datos_actual$Nutriente)){

cat("\n\n---\n\n")
cat("## ", nombres[nut], "\n\n")

df <- filter(datos_actual, Nutriente == nut)

print(graficar(df))

cat("\n\n### Estadísticas\n\n")

estad <- summarise(df,
Promedio=mean(Valor,na.rm=TRUE),
Mínimo=min(Valor,na.rm=TRUE),
Máximo=max(Valor,na.rm=TRUE))

print(knitr::kable(estad,digits=2))

cat("\n\n### Resultados\n\n")

print(knitr::kable(
select(df,Finca, Fecha, Lote,Valor,Min,Max,Estado),
digits=2))

df_comp <- comparacion |>
  filter(Nutriente == nut)

cat("\n\n### Comparación con el año anterior\n\n")

print(graficar_comparacion(df_comp))

}
```
